Digital Tennis simulator with AI tracking & 3D visuals for solo/duel modes. Perfect for training & entertainment.



>> Features of Tennis Simulator:


  • AI Tracking: Real-time movement and shot analysis for personalized training.

  • Solo & Duel Modes: Play alone or compete against others for a thrilling experience.

  • 3D Visuals: High-quality 3D graphics that replicate the feel of real tennis matches.

  • Interactive Gameplay: Advanced controls and AI opponents that adjust to your skill level.

  • Realistic Physics: Accurate ball movement, spin, and court dynamics for an authentic simulation.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Tennis Simulator:


Training Tool: Ideal for tennis players looking to improve technique, reaction time, and strategy.


Entertainment & Recreation: A fun and engaging experience for tennis fans or anyone who enjoys sports simulations.


Flexible Setup: Suitable for home use, sports clubs, and training academies.


Real-Time Performance Feedback: Provides detailed insights into your gameplay, helping you track progress and set goals.


Customization Options: Allows users to adjust difficulty levels, court surfaces, and play styles.



>> Product Number: LJST003


  • Floor area: 10m*4.5m*3m

  • Number of people: 1-2 person

  • Participation time: 3-10 minutes

  • Power: 600w



>> FAQs for Tennis Simulator:


Q1: Is this suitable for beginners?

A1: Yes, the Tennis Simulator can be adjusted for various skill levels, from beginners to advanced players.


Q2: Do I need special equipment to play?

A2: You can play with standard tennis accessories, such as a racket or controller, depending on the setup. The simulator can be integrated with motion-tracking technology or used with traditional controllers.


Q3: How realistic is the simulation?

A3: The simulation features advanced AI and real-time physics to create a highly realistic tennis experience, including shot placement, ball spin, and court dynamics.


Q4: Can I play against other users online?

A4: Yes, the Tennis Simulator supports multiplayer duel modes, allowing you to compete against other players online or in split-screen mode.


Q5: How do the AI opponents adjust to my skill level?

A5: The AI adjusts its difficulty based on your performance, providing a dynamic challenge that grows with your skill level.
